The result matches what I expected. After saving, the MDN Web Docs link showed up as a card under "All bookmarks" with its name and web address, the count went up, and I got a clear confirmation that it was saved.

And yes, the overall approach feels right to me — starting with a single clear "Add your first bookmark" button, having it open a short form, and then seeing the saved link appear in the list is exactly the kind of simple, no-hassle flow I was hoping for.
